Four different drivers won at least one race in 2025: Lando Norris, Max Verstappen, Oscar Piastri and George Russell.

The 2025 final standings list the win totals: Norris 7, Verstappen 8, Piastri 7, Russell 2. Every other driver in the standings has 0 wins. These add up to 24 wins, which matches the 24 rounds of the season. The constructors' totals agree (McLaren 14, Red Bull 8, Mercedes 2). I did not check each of the 24 race reports individually.

ANSWER: 4
